searchText: light clients can subtract pubkeys to match the given participation on a particular aggregate signature, the idea w/ the aggregate is to facilitate less computation in the expected/optimistic case w/ relatively high participation (only a few subtractions, rather than starting from 0 and adding the full committee together)
